messages:
jordan_cs: Hey team — escalating from a customer on Friday. They hit our /v1/rerank endpoint and are getting 400s and weird score outputs. They say the schema in docs is ambiguous and their client lib auto-flattens 'query' into 'input.query'.

jordan_cs: Customer payload (redacted) that failed locally:
```json
{
  "model": "rwd/rerank-v1",
  "query": "how to reset password",
  "documents": [
    { "id": "d1", "text": "Reset steps", "passages": [{"start":0,"text":"step1"}] },
    { "id": "d2", "text": "Forgot pw" }
  ]
}
```

jordan_cs: Error returned:
```
400 Bad Request: field 'documents' expects array of strings or objects with 'content', but found nested 'passages' array. Hint: use 'candidates' for per-passage reranking.
```

samira_eng: Hmm — docs currently mention both 'documents' and 'candidates' in different sections. If client sent per-passage objects under documents that could trigger validation.

samira_eng: Can you ask customer to try replacing 'documents' with 'candidates' where each candidate is a passage object? Example payload that worked for me:
```json
{
  "model":"rwd/rerank-v1",
  "query":"how to reset password",
  "candidates":[
    {"id":"d1p1","text":"step1"},
    {"id":"d2p1","text":"forgot pw"}
  ]
}
```

ben_chen: @samira_eng we recently updated the validator to disallow nested 'passages' under 'documents' to simplify scoring semantics. But our docs still show an example using 'passages' inside documents — bug.

ben_chen: The scoring code expects candidates as the atomic unit. When people pass documents with passages we try to flatten them but there is an edge-case where both 'candidates' and 'documents' are present and we dedupe by id incorrectly which results in identical scores (0.0) for all items. That might explain the "weird score outputs" comment.

morgan_sre: Do we have logs for the customer request? @jordan_cs can you paste the request id or timestamp so we can trace in ingestion? Deploy-bot should've created a trace if it hit prod.

jordan_cs: Request id from customer: req_20260312_8b9f. They said this started after SDK v0.9.1 — client now converts 'input.query' to top-level 'query' automatically. Also included stack trace showing the 400. I forwarded the original request to reproduce.

ben_chen: Good. Repro plan:
1) Run their original payload against a sandbox instance — confirm 400.
2) Try variants: a) move passages to candidates, b) remove passages, c) include both candidates and documents to reproduce dedupe.
3) If dedupe bug reproduces, add regression test and a validator change that returns a clearer error pointing to 'use candidates for passage-level reranking'.

samira_eng: For immediate CS workaround, ask them to send one of:
- flatten all passages into 'candidates' (recommended)
- send documents with plain 'text' only (no passages)

jordan_cs: I sent that and they're trying the flatten approach now. They also asked whether the query field can be nested as "input": {"query":...} because their SDK wraps payloads that way.

ben_chen: Our endpoint only accepts top-level 'query' (legacy) and we haven't shipped support for nested 'input.query'. We should add compatibility layer or normalize incoming payloads in the router. Filing an infra task: RERANK-compat-query-wrapper.

morgan_sre: Quick note — if we add normalization, watch out for request size expansion when we duplicate fields. Also ensure traceability: keep original payload in audit logs.

ben_chen: I'll add a small shim in request parsing to accept input.query and map to query, validate that both aren't present simultaneously. Also patch docs to show canonical examples (candidates vs documents) and call out passage-level guidance.

jordan_cs: Customer tried flattening and got a 200 with meaningful scores. They still want clearer error msg if they send nested passages under documents. They're happy to be a beta tester for the SDK normalization.

samira_eng: Thanks. I'll update the KB article with exact repro steps and a copy-pastable flatten script and link to the ticket RERANK-compat-query-wrapper.

deploy-bot: Created ticket RERANK-compat-query-wrapper (#4521) and assigned to @ben_chen. ETA: 3 working days.

jordan_cs: Closing loop with customer now. Keeping thread open until patch is rolled. :thumbsup:
